Headline: 🏆 BLESS Futures Carnival · Trade & Win Up to 2,130 USDT!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The BLESS Futures Carnival is officially live! Trade BLESSUSDT Perpetual Futures, complete campaign tasks, and unlock tiered rewards worth up to 2,130 USDT.
Trade BLESSUSDT Perpetual Futures, reach trading volume milestones, complete campaign tasks, and earn more rewards throughout the campaign.

November 22 — November 28, 2026 (UTC)
## 🎁 Total Prize Pool
Up to 2,130 USDT in Futures Coupons

BLESS Futures Trading Milestone: Up to 2,020 USDT

BLESS Perpetual Futures
## How to Join
- Register or log in to your Biconomy account.
- Complete campaign tasks and trade BLESSUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign.
- Unlock trading volume tiers to earn Futures Coupons — the more you trade, the more you win.

## Terms & Conditions
- Trade BLESSUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign. Cumulative trading volume includes both opening and closing orders, as well as Long and Short positions.
- Unlock trading volume milestones to earn Futures Coupon rewards. Higher cumulative trading volume unlocks higher reward tiers.
- Rewards from all unlocked tiers are cumulative. For example, if a user reaches 10,000 USDT in cumulative BLESSUSDT Futures trading volume, they will unlock the corresponding milestone and receive the total rewards from all unlocked tiers.
- Complete campaign tasks to earn additional rewards, including Cumulative Deposit Tasks, First BLESSUSDT Futures Trade, and Invite Friends.
- Each eligible user can receive up to 2,130 USDT in total rewards during the campaign. Rewards will be distributed automatically based on completed tasks and unlocked trading milestones.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled orders will not be counted.
- Futures Coupons may be used as trading margin. Profits generated using Futures Coupons are withdrawable, while the coupons themselves are non-withdrawable.
- Fraudulent activities, including self-trading, wash trading, or any form of market manipulation, are strictly prohibited and will result in disqualification.
- Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Prediction Markets Crypto Kickoff Week: 20,000 USDT in First-Trade and Leaderboard Rewards

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Gate Prediction Markets Crypto Kickoff Week is live. Register, trade short-term events in the Crypto section, and use scratch cards. New users can earn 10 USDT for their first trade, and all eligible users can compete on the Advanced Prediction Leaderboard for a share of 15,000 USDT.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 17, 2026, 08:00 (UTC) – November 24, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## How to Join and Which Trades Qualify
Click [Join Now] on the event page to register, then trade short-term events in the Crypto section of Gate Prediction Markets.
Only trades on short-term crypto events count. Trades on long-term crypto events or events in other sections do not count.
Trades funded with Prediction Vouchers or other subsidies do not count toward eligible trading volume, the first-trade reward, or the leaderboard.
## Benefit 1: New User First-Trade Reward — Share 5,000 USDT
The first 500 new users who register during the event, make their first trade on Gate Prediction Markets, and meet both conditions below will each receive 10 USDT:
Your first filled buy order must be for a short-term crypto event and have a filled value of at least 20 USDT.
Use at least 2 eligible scratch cards after registering and before the event ends.
Rewards go to users in the order they meet all requirements. Each user can claim the reward once.
You qualify as a new user if you've never traded on Gate Prediction Markets. Your first trade is your first filled buy order. If its filled value is below 20 USDT, later orders cannot make up the difference.
## Benefit 2: Advanced Prediction Leaderboard — Share 15,000 USDT
After registering, new users can qualify for the leaderboard by trading at least 5,000 USDT in eligible volume and using at least 500 eligible scratch cards during the event.
Users who meet both requirements are ranked by cumulative eligible trading volume, from highest to lowest. The top 500 can earn rewards based on the trading volume and scratch card requirements for each tier:
Rank | Minimum Cumulative Eligible Trading Volume | Minimum Eligible Scratch Cards Used | Rewards
1st–5th Place | ≥ 600,000 USDT | ≥ 60,000 | Share 5,000 USDT
6th–10th Place | ≥ 400,000 USDT | ≥ 40,000 | Share 3,000 USDT
11th–20th Place | ≥ 200,000 USDT | ≥ 20,000 | Share 2,000 USDT, up to 100 USDT per user
21st–500th Place | ≥ 5,000 USDT | ≥ 500 | Share 5,000 USDT, up to 50 USDT per user
## Prediction Trading Volume Leaderboard Rules
To earn a tier reward, you must meet both the minimum cumulative eligible trading volume and the minimum number of scratch cards used for that tier.
Your initial rank determines which tier is checked first. If you miss either requirement, each lower tier is checked in order until you meet both requirements for a tier. Moving to a lower tier does not change your initial rank or move anyone else up.
Users who move down share the prize pool with the other eligible users in that tier. As a result, a tier can have more winners than the number of ranks shown in the table. Each user can earn a reward from only one leaderboard tier.
Individual reward = (your cumulative eligible trading volume ÷ total cumulative prediction trading volume of all users in your tier) × your tier's prize pool. The per-user cap for your tier still applies.
The per-user reward cap for the tier corresponding to ranks 11–20 is 100 USDT; the cap for the tier corresponding to ranks 21–500 is 50 USDT. The same caps apply to users who move down into those tiers.
If two users have the same cumulative eligible trading volume, the user who first reached that volume and met the minimum scratch card requirement ranks higher.
## How Scratch Cards Work
In the “Cryptocurrency” section of Prediction Markets, users earn 1 Prediction Points Scratch Card for every 10 USDT in cumulative valid trading volume. Scratch cards earned from other prediction categories also count toward the scratch-card requirement. Trading volume and the number of cards actually scratched must be verified separately. For example, reaching 5,000 USDT in cumulative valid trading volume still requires users to scratch at least 500 valid cards to meet the leaderboard’s minimum eligibility requirements.
When using the bulk scratch feature, the count is based on the number of valid scratch cards actually used. For example, scratching 10 valid cards in one batch counts as 10 scratches.
For more details, please refer to: Gate Events Market: Events Points Are Now Live. Trade for Scratch Cards, Unlock Multiple Rewards, and Enter a New Drawing Every Monday
## Prediction Voucher Terms of Use
All event rewards are issued as Prediction Vouchers. You can use them only to trade on Gate Prediction Markets. You cannot withdraw the voucher amount.
You can withdraw profits from trades made with Prediction Vouchers.
Use Prediction Vouchers before the expiration date shown on the voucher. Any unused balance expires automatically.
## Important Notes
To receive rewards, click [Join Now] on the event page to register and complete Identity Verification. This event is open to selected users who meet the eligibility requirements. If you can't register, your account is currently ineligible. Check the event page for your eligibility.
Only eligible trades filled after registration, during the event, and in markets listed on the event page count. You must trade with your own funds. Positions and profits from Prediction Vouchers or other subsidies do not count.
Eligible trading volume is based on the filled value of trades, including buys of Yes or No positions and sales on the secondary market. Unfilled orders, unfilled portions of canceled orders, transfers, refunds, and abnormal trades do not count.
If events are delayed, canceled, rescheduled, or interrupted, if rulings change or markets close, or if other events beyond its control occur, Gate may adjust, suspend, or cancel the affected markets and event rewards.
All rewards are issued as Prediction Vouchers. You cannot withdraw, transfer, or cash out the voucher amount. You can withdraw any profits according to the product rules. See the voucher for eligible markets, expiration, and how profits are handled.
Once approved, rewards will be issued within 14 business days after the event ends. If you join other Gate events of the same type at the same time, you can earn rewards from only one event, subject to Gate's review and the rules on the event page.
Only one eligible main account per verified identity may participate. Subaccounts, API users, VIP 15 and above, market makers, corporate accounts, institutional accounts, and restricted accounts are ineligible.
Gate Prediction Markets services may be subject to the laws and regulations of the user's jurisdiction. Users must comply with the Gate User Agreement. Before participating, users should check their local laws and regulations and the platform's terms of service, assess their own risk tolerance, and make sure they are eligible. Users in restricted regions may be unable to access some or all services, including registration, trading, making predictions, claiming rewards, or participating in this event.
This event is not directed at users in regions where prediction markets, wagering, contracts for difference, derivatives, or crypto asset trading are prohibited or restricted. Users must not use VPNs, proxies, false identities, third parties acting on their behalf, or any other means to bypass regional restrictions, KYC requirements, or Gate's risk controls.
This event does not constitute investment advice, wagering advice, advice on predicting sports outcomes, a financial promotion, or a promise of returns. Prediction Markets, crypto assets, and related trading carry risks including price volatility, liquidity, settlement, market closures, and compliance. Please participate with caution.
Bulk registration of secondary accounts, artificial volume inflation, self-trading, collusive wash trading, manipulation of prediction outcomes, fake referrals, fake shares, voucher arbitrage, exploitation of system vulnerabilities, and other conduct that undermines the fairness of the event are prohibited. All accounts under the same verified identity count as one participant. Subaccounts are ineligible.
Gate may adjust, suspend, or cancel the event rules, prize pool, reward distribution, eligibility, or event period without notice due to market conditions, changes to sporting events, system issues, compliance requirements, or events beyond its control. Gate reserves the right to make the final interpretation of this event.
